sourceClaims.claim: Status.svg fixes 30px pill geometry and observed paint pairs
repeated pairs form reusable paint families without universal meanings
visible text and consumer context own meaning; role=status is not implicit

evidence.source-integrity: pass: raw Status.svg geometry and paint families are asserted without semantic renaming
evidence.structural-contract: pass: shared guard classifies every executable and live Status root
evidence.runtime-browser: not-applicable: Status is a static textual primitive and application rendering owns changes
evidence.accessibility: pass: labels remain unfocusable text without implicit live-region semantics or color-only meaning
evidence.focused-visual: pass: component-local computed paint matrix covers all public modifiers
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace filtering preserves state-to-label rendering across rerenders
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long text remains component-bounded in a narrow table cell

staticVisual: pass: source paint matrix is static visual evidence only
realInteractionVisual: pass: non-interactive Status default computed paint is verified; hover/focus/active are not material states
runtimeBehavior: pass: non-interactive ownership is asserted by absence of role, tabindex and control descendants

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: paint matrix, long label, narrow table cell and Data Workspace filtering inspected; pointer/keyboard states are not meaningful

findings.description: Six exact source paint pairs are below the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold; text still states meaning and Wave 4 does not recolor source authority.

knownLimitations: domain status-to-paint mapping and live announcements are consumer-owned
